newsitem.title: FRANCE: French centre-right holds narrow lead - poll.
newsitem.headline: French centre-right holds narrow lead - poll.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of voters' intentions ahead of the May 25/June 1 parlimentary election. It was conducted by Louis Harris on April 28 for French weekly magazine Valeurs Actuelles and made public on Tuesday:

Harris said that 25 percent of those polled expressed no opinion. Fully 31 percent said they could change their mind before the May 25-June 1 parliamentary election, while 69 percent said they were sure of their choice.
The poll was based on a survey of 945 individuals aged 18 and over. Only the preferences of those individuals who said they were both inscribed on voter lists and certain to vote were counted.
